name: Telegraph
description: Dots and dashes on a paper tape, the tape running through every cell.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 40%; width: 100%; height: 20%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 @pick(8%, 22%), transparent @pick(8%, 22%) @pick(20%, 34%)); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 @pick(8%, 22%), transparent @pick(8%, 22%) @pick(20%, 34%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8%; width: 100%; height: 5%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
